items.title: The quotient map of an etale equivalence relation is etale and surjective
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for an etale equivalence relation j = (s, t) : R -> U x_S U on a scheme U over S whose quotient U/R is an algebraic space, the map U -> U/R is etale and surjective, so that (U, R, U -> U/R) is a presentation (source lines 1647-1656). The proof tests the map after base change along an arbitrary T -> U/R, rewrites the fppf description of such a morphism to identify T x_{U/R} U with T_i x_{a_i, U, t} R over a covering, and concludes by fpqc locality of surjectivity and etaleness.
